Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology
Tasmania

Updated Marine Wind Warning Summary for Tasmania
Issued at 10:00 am EDT on Wednesday 4 November 2026
for the period until midnight EDT Thursday 5 November 2026.

Wind Warnings for Wednesday 4 November
Strong Wind Warning for the following area:
Far North West Coast

Wind Warnings for Thursday 5 November
Strong Wind Warning for the following areas:
Far North West Coast, Central North Coast, Banks Strait and Franklin Sound,
East of Flinders Island, Upper East Coast, Lower East Coast, South East Coast,
South West Coast and Central West Coast

The next marine wind warning summary will be issued by 4:05 pm EDT Wednesday.
